description: pac solution create-settings: the JSON that maps every connection reference (to a connection id in the target environment) and environment variable (to a target value). Pass connectionReferences / environmentVariables to fill values; the result lists what is still unmapped.

connectionReferences.description: logicalName -> connectionId in the target environment

copilotAgents.description: agent schema name -> Entra security group id allowed to use the agent in the target

regenerate.description: Recreate the file even if it exists (mappings are lost)

settingsFile.description: Default <solutionDir>/deployment-settings.json or next to the zip

zip.description: Solution zip (or use solutionDir from cs_pull_solution)

name: cs_create_deployment_settings
title: Create or update deployment settings
